text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 6 lengths of 1650 mm from 3/4 in EMT.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw square (a pipe cutter or a fine blade); deburr inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and out with a reamer and a file, and wipe clean.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark one line along the whole tube with a straight edge. Every hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is on that line: the button hole at end A on the line, the button

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole at end B on the opposite side (turn the tube half a turn).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre punch, drill 3 mm, then 6 mm for the button holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hitch pin holes: 8 mm right through, 15 mm from each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the marked line (drill both walls in one pass in a vee

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: block so the holes line up).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint a 40 mm colour band (post colour) at each end, starting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 70 mm in, so it shows beside the socket mouth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push a 3/4 in snap button into each end, V spring first, until

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the button clicks into its 6 mm hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the end slides into a socket to the stop and clicks.
